title: The Lawyer's Letter
intro: An email from a law firm says you are being sued, unless you settle today.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Legal notice: you are being sued

subject.text: LEGAL NOTICE: you are being sued

p: A claim has been filed against you for

p.text: Settle today to avoid court. After today the amount will double.
We act for a client who wishes to remain anonymous.

addr.label: A strange address
addr.lens: It comes from harlowfinch-legal.net, not a normal law firm address.
addr.why: Look at the address behind the name.

claim.label: Unpaid dues you do not know
claim.lens: You owe nothing you can think of.
claim.why: A claim you do not recognise needs checking, not paying.

settle.label: Settle today or it doubles
settle.lens: A deadline and a doubling penalty.
settle.why: A hard deadline stops you thinking.

link.label: A "settle now" link
link.lens: It leads to a payment page.
link.why: Real firms do not ask you to settle through an email link.

who.label: An anonymous client
who.lens: They will not say who is suing you.
who.why: A real claim names who is making it.

greet.label: "Dear Sir or Madam"
greet.why: Vague greetings are common, but not proof alone.

actions.label: Search for the firm and call a number I look up myself

trap.title: Harlow & Finch · Settle
trap.ask: Pay $1,850 by card to settle the claim.

block_report.line: Reported as phishing and deleted. The fake address was blocked.

verify.line: No such firm existed on the official register, and no claim had been filed. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The page copied your card. The "claim" never existed, and the money was gone.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking whether the firm really exists would have ended it. A real claim names who is suing you.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A legal threat with a deadline and a payment link is a scam. Check that the firm exists, on a number you look up yourself.

quick_check.q: An email says you are being sued and must settle today through a link. What do you do?

options.text: Do not click. Check the firm yourself, and report the email

quick_check.explain: A real claim names who is suing you and gives time. This one hurried you.

hints.nudge: Who is the claim from, and how much time did they give you?

rows.v: Look up the firm yourself and call it
